instructions: Place {target} on the table between {left_anchor} and {right_anchor}, to the right of the former and left of the latter, as seen from in front of the robot.
Put {target} in the gap between {left_anchor} and {right_anchor}. It should be right of {left_anchor} and left of {right_anchor} in the camera view.
The goal is for {target} to rest between the two other cubes: right of {left_anchor} and left of {right_anchor}, viewed from in front of the robot.
Find the space right of {left_anchor} and left of {right_anchor}, using the view from in front of the robot, and set {target} there on the table.
notes: Requires one movable cube to satisfy opposing spatial relations to two separate landmarks simultaneously.
